# Job Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 420r

---

**11:1** And-answered Tsofar [Zophar] the-Naamathite [ha-Na'amatiy] and-said:

**11:2** "Shall-a-multitude [rov] of-words [devarim] not be-answered [lo ye'aneh]?
Or shall-a-man of-lips [ish sefatayim] be-justified [yitsddaq]?

**11:3** Your-boasting [baddeykha] — shall-men [metim] be-silent [yacharishu]?
And-you-mock [vattilag] and-there-is-no-one shaming [makhlim]?

**11:4** And-you-say [va-tomer], 'Pure [zakh] [is] my-teaching [liqqchiy],
and-clean [bar] I-am in-your-eyes [be-eineykha].'

**11:5** But [ve-ulam] — who will-grant [mi yitten] God [eloah] would-speak [dabber],
and-open [ve-yiftach] his-lips [sefatav] with-you [immakh]!

**11:6** And-he-would-tell-you [ve-yagged lekha] the-secrets [ta'alumot] of-wisdom [chokhmah],
for double [kiflayim] to-sound-wisdom [le-tushiyyah].
And-know [ve-da] that God [eloah] forgets [yashsheh] for-you
some of-your-iniquity [me-avonekha].

**11:7** Can-you-find [ha-cheqer] the-searching-out of-God [eloah]?
Or until the-limit [takhlit] of-Shaddai [the Almighty] can-you-find [timtsa]?

**11:8** Heights of-the-heavens [gevhei shamayim] — what can-you-do [mah tif'al]?
Deeper than-Sheol [mi-sheol] — what can-you-know [mah tedda]?

**11:9** Longer [arukkah] than-the-earth [me-erets] its-measure [middah],
and-broader [u-rechavah] than-the-sea [minni yam].

**11:10** If he-passes-through [yachalof] and-shuts-up [vayasgir],
and-he-convenes [yaqhil] — who can-turn-him-back [yeshivennu]?

**11:11** For he knows [yada] men of-worthlessness [metei shav];
and-he-sees [vayar] iniquity [aven] — and-does-he-not consider [ve-lo yitbonen]?

**11:12** And-a-hollow [nuvav] man [ish] will-get-understanding [yillavev],
and-a-colt [ayir] of-a-wild-donkey [pere] — a-man [adam] will-be-born [yivvaled].

**11:13** If you [attah] set-right [hakhinota] your-heart [libbakha],
and-stretch-out [u-farashta] to-him your-hands [kappeykha];

**11:14** if iniquity [aven] [is] in-your-hand [be-yadekha] — put-it-far-away [harciqehu],
and-do-not let-dwell [al tashken] in-your-tents [be-ohaleykha] wickedness [avlah] —

**11:15** for then [ki az] you-will-lift [tissa] your-face [paneykha] without blemish [mi-mum],
and-you-will-be firm [mutsaq] and-you-will-not fear [ve-lo tira].

**11:16** For you [attah] — trouble [amal] you-will-forget [tishkach];
like-waters [ke-mayim] that-passed [averu] you-will-remember-it [tizkhor].

**11:17** And-above noonday [mi-tsohorayim] will-arise [yaqum] your-span-of-life [cheled];
darkness [tu'afah] — like-the-morning [ka-boqer] it-will-be [tiheyeh].

**11:18** And-you-will-trust [u-vatachta] because there-is [ki yesh] hope [tiqvah];
and-you-will-search [ve-chafartah] — in-security [la-vetach] you-will-lie-down [tishkav].

**11:19** And-you-will-lie-down [ve-ravatsta] and-none [ve-ein] will-make-you-tremble [macharid];
and-many [rabbim] will-entreat [ve-chillu] your-face [faneykha].

**11:20** But-the-eyes [ve-einei] of-the-wicked [resha'im] will-fail [tikhlehna],
and-refuge [manos] will-perish [avad] from-them,
and-their-hope [ve-tiqvatam] — a-breathing-out of-soul [mappach nefesh]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "God forgets for you some of your iniquity":** Tsofar's most cutting line — he claims that Iyyov's punishment is actually *less* than he deserves. God has been lenient by overlooking part of his sin. This goes beyond Elifaz and Bildad; Tsofar assumes guilt and calls God's current punishment merciful.

**v.7-9 — The dimensions of divine wisdom:** The fourfold spatial metaphor — higher than heavens, deeper than Sheol, longer than the earth, wider than the sea — is the most comprehensive description of God's unsearchable wisdom in the dialogues. It anticipates God's own cosmic tour in chapters 38-41.

**v.12 — "a wild donkey's colt born as a man":** This proverb is notoriously difficult. The Hebrew suggests that a hollow/empty man gaining sense is as likely as a wild donkey being born human — that is, impossible. It is likely an insult directed at Iyyov.

---
*— EMET*
